notes:
- **Command Mode: select text, hold the key and say what to do with it.** "Make this shorter and friendlier", "turn this into bullet points", "translate this into German": the answer replaces the selection in one paste, so your program's own Undo takes it back, and Esc cancels before it. With nothing selected, what you ask for ("write a reply saying Thursday works") is typed at the cursor. Off until you switch it on under **Settings › Dictation › Command Mode**, and it needs a language model. See [Command Mode](/docs/transcribe/#command-mode).
- **Only the instruction and the selected text leave your PC**, to the language model you chose for it. It only ever produces text, treats the selection as material and never as instructions, refuses a selection over 8,000 characters, and changes nothing when it cannot read the selection or the model is too slow.
